meaning: the presentation point has what the older Map Creator dialect states about it instead: the relay-or-RTP kind it serves, and its position number at the station

schema.$comment: Open to fields a newer producer adds (SPEC §9). Derived from `records.rs`'s field map by `vocabulary()`; edit the map, not this.

entity_id.description: One entity of this document, by identity. A declared identity is a UUID; a derived one is its root UUID and the generator's key path, which nothing in a converted document produces.
entity_id.title: entity_id

legacy_value.description: A legacy value the dump wrote, kept verbatim in whatever JSON kind it wrote it. It states no type on purpose: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and correcting a kind here would be the converter deciding what the site meant.
legacy_value.title: legacy_value

schema.description: the presentation point has what the older Map Creator dialect states about it instead: the relay-or-RTP kind it serves, and its position number at the station

cell.description: The cell Map Creator's `coordinate` names, by entity identity. The export writes the legacy spelling back from the identity, so no display string is load-bearing here (SPEC §2).

cell_unresolved.description: Map Creator's `coordinate` verbatim, present only when the cell it names is not in this dump. Never corrected and never dropped: the round trip writes back what the dump said, and the ledger counts it as a dangling source reference.

point_type.description: Map Creator's `type`, carried as the export states it.

station.description: The station this record belongs to, by entity identity. A point sits inside its station's own record rather than naming it, so the reference is the import's and the export rebuilds the nesting from it.

schema.title: station_point
